class.name: MultiLayeredSurfaceMap
class.description: Display plugin for a Multi-Level Surface Map (MLS).
Goal tool that picks the true 3D point on the rendered MLS/traversability map (instead of the z=0 ground plane) and publishes it as PoseStamped.
Appends a 3D waypoint (picked on the rendered MLS/traversability map) to the planner's waypoint queue; the queue is planned through on the next goal.
Draws a polygonal keep-out zone on the map (left-click vertices, minimum 3, right-click to close); the planner marks the covered traversability nodes as obstacles.
Field operator panel: live planner status plus one-click waypoint-queue and map save/republish actions.
